description: This Java source file defines the StaticContentController class, a Spring MVC controller responsible for managing static content files in the admin section of a SalesManager web application. It includes endpoints for viewing, listing, saving, and removing static content files, and integrates with content service and web UI components.

classes.name: StaticContentController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing static content files within the admin interface, including operations like listing, uploading, and removing static files.

methods.name: getContentImages
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the static content files management page.

methods.name: pageStaticContent
methods.description: Handles POST requests to list static content files with their metadata and paths in JSON format.

methods.name: saveFiles
methods.description: Handles POST requests to upload and save new static content files.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a specified static content file.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Prepares and sets the menu context for views.
